description: Assess one disrupted flight under EU261/UK261: works out which scheme applies (or none), route distance and band, whether fixed compensation is due and how much (EUR/GBP), care rights, the stated reason's effect, and next steps. Use for 'what am I owed for my flight?'. Do NOT use to write the claim; use generate_claim_letter.

arrival.description: Final arrival airport 3-letter IATA code, case-insensitive, e.g. JFK

arrival_delay_hours.description: Hours late at the final destination, e.g. 4.5. Drives delay compensation (>= 3h) and care. Default 0.

carrier_country.description: Operating airline's 2-letter country code, e.g. DE for Lufthansa, US for United. Needed for flights arriving into the EU/UK from outside.

departure.description: Departure airport 3-letter IATA code, case-insensitive, e.g. LHR

disrupted.description: What happened: delayed (arrived late) or cancelled.

distance_km.description: Override the computed great-circle distance in km, e.g. 5540. Both airports must still be known IATA codes.

notice_days.description: For cancellations: days of notice the airline gave before departure, e.g. 3. 14+ days means no fixed compensation. Default 0.

reason_category.description: Cause the airline gave: weather, atc, security, political, strike_atc (third-party strike) are exempt; technical, strike_airline, other are not; crew is case-by-case. Default unknown.

reroute_arrival_delay_hours.description: For re-routed cancellations: hours the replacement arrived after the original schedule, e.g. 2. Default 0.

rerouted.description: For cancellations: true if the airline re-routed you on another flight. Default false.

name: check_compensation

band.description: Distance band: short <=1500 km, medium <=3500 km, long beyond.

due.description: Whether EU261/UK261 care is owed for this disruption (always false when no scheme applies).

items.description: Care items owed (empty when not due).

note.description: When care starts for this band, or why no scheme care applies.

amount.description: Amount due, or null when none.

currency.description: EUR for EU261, GBP for UK261, null when no scheme.

eligible.description: true, false, or 'possibly' when the reason is unknown or crew-related.

disclaimer.description: Not-legal-advice disclaimer to show the user.

distance_km.description: Route distance in km used for the band.

jurisdiction_reason.description: Why that scheme does or does not apply.

exempt.description: Whether it exempts the airline: true, false, 'possibly' or 'unknown'.

scheme.description: Passenger-rights scheme that applies to this route.

title: Check compensation
